about_short_description.short_description: Voicepanel makes it simple for businesses to obtain valuable feedback on their products and services.

product.name: Voicepanel AI Research Agent
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates user research by conducting hundreds of research sessions to collect detailed feedback on products and services.

product.name: Built-in Participant Recruiting
product.description: A recruitment service that sources qualified participants from customer bases or a panel of over 10 million consumers and professionals worldwide.

product.name: Interactive Analysis and Reporting
product.description: A feature that organizes qualitative and quantitative user feedback into searchable reports with summaries, thematic analysis, and multimedia evidence.

product.name: Screen Recording Usability Testing
product.description: A usability testing service that captures user interactions and feedback through screen sharing and recorded sessions.
